title: billingPayment
description: EWDS topic published by the Billing & Payment Service (Blooo, T5.6) at every payment status change. A payment settles one billingInvoice and goes directly from the consumer to the producer's payment-provider account. Derived from int:Payment (schemas/v1.0.0/billing/Payment.json) without PSP references (stripeIds). Contains no personal data. DRAFT proposed by Blooo to EWAG.

paymentId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:paymentId. UUID v4.

invoiceId.description: FK to billingInvoice. IRI: int:invoiceId. UUID v4.

communityId.description: [Extension] FK to the Community. UUID v4.

billingMode.description: [Extension] live or virtual (payment provider test environment).

payerId.description: [Extension] FK to the consumer Actor. UUID v4.

payeeId.description: [Extension] FK to the producer Actor. UUID v4.

paymentDate.description: Date and time the payment succeeded. IRI: int:paymentDate. ISO 8601 with timezone.

paymentAmount.description: Payment amount, in the invoice currency. IRI: int:paymentAmount.

failureCategory.description: [Extension] Non-personal failure category when paymentStatus = failed (supports KPI UE-3).
